in_marathi.name: Gajvadan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajvadan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajvadan is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It refers to a deity or a person with the face or appearance of an elephant. The name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes strength, wisdom, and power.
